VENDOR CONTRACT CLAUSE READER · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

Find the cancel-by date and the bad clauses before a SaaS contract renews itself.

Paste the agreement or order form. The page pulls out the term, auto-renewal and cancel-by date, annual fee and price increases, shows what a missed deadline commits you to, builds a dated calendar you can add to your phone, and flags the clauses buyers push back on: list-price renewals, vendor-changes-terms-at-will, no exit, uncapped or tiny liability, one-way indemnity. Each value shows the sentence it came from so you can check it.

The text is read in this browser tab and never leaves your device. It reads wording with fixed rules; it is not a lawyer and does not decide whether a contract is fair or enforceable.

Clauses to look at

What it reads, and what it leaves to you

  • Extracted: start date, initial term, auto-renewal and renewal length, non-renewal notice days, annual or monthly fee, annual price increase, CPI or list-price renewal, payment days, late interest, liability cap, uptime, data deletion window.
  • Flagged: long cancel windows, full-term renewals, list-price renewals, vendor-amends-at-will, no termination right, non-refundable fees, true-ups, short payment terms, suspension without notice, liability caps and missing carve-outs, one-way indemnity, missing data terms, arbitration.
  • Not decided: whether any term is fair or enforceable where you are, what price to accept, or whether to sign. Terms in a separate order form, exhibit or linked policy are not seen unless you paste them.

Common questions

What is a vendor contract auto-renewal clause?

A clause saying the agreement renews for another term unless you give written notice before a deadline. The deadline is often 30 to 90 days before the term ends, and the renewal is often a full year. Missing it commits you to the next term's fees.

How far ahead do I have to cancel a SaaS contract?

It depends on the contract; 30, 60 and 90 days are all common. This page finds the notice period in your text and counts back from the end of the term to give a date, then lets you add it to your calendar with a 30-day alarm.

What does 'then-current list price' at renewal mean?

The vendor can charge whatever its published price is at renewal, not the price you negotiated. Ask for a fixed cap on renewal increases, for example 3 to 5%, or CPI.

What should a limitation of liability clause include?

A cap that is meaningful relative to the risk (many buyers ask for 2x annual fees or more), mutual application, and carve-outs for data breach, confidentiality breach, indemnities, and gross negligence or willful misconduct.

What is termination for convenience?

The right to end the contract early without a reason, usually with notice. Without it, a multi-year term means you owe the remaining fees even if you stop using the product.

Does this replace a lawyer?

No. It reads wording with fixed rules, shows the sentence each value came from so you can check it, and says what buyers commonly ask for. It does not decide whether terms are fair or enforceable where you are.

Is my contract uploaded anywhere?

No. The text is read in your browser and nothing is sent; a test in the code asserts there are no network calls.

No warranty. This tool is provided free and as-is, without warranty of any kind, express or implied. It is not legal, tax, accounting, compliance, real estate, or financial advice, and it does not replace an attorney. Extracted values can be wrong or missing; check every one against the contract. A clean result means these rules found nothing, not that a contract is safe.

Contract data. A contract can name prices and parties that are commercially sensitive. This page runs in your browser and sends nothing anywhere, and the portfolio never receives it. Closing the tab discards it; downloads are files on your own device.

Best-effort hosting, no SLA. These tools are free, experimental, and may be slow, broken, moved, or taken offline without notice. We do not promise uptime, backups of anything you type, or that a URL will keep working. Do not use this as a system of record: nothing you enter is saved anywhere.

Everything runs in your browser. Your text is never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (contract_read, example_loaded, summary_downloaded, ics_downloaded, csv_downloaded) are counted only in local storage on your device, never with any of your data, and are switched off by Do Not Track.
